decision: Retain the 1x budget. Mean throughput is 1,303.1 examples/s versus 1,210.2 at 2x and 1,198.8 at 3x. Larger budgets take 7.67% and 8.69% more time for the same examples, with greater memory use. Both reversed-order repeats reject a speed improvement. All regular and 130-example extreme tests completed with finite updates; fewer GPU chunks did not improve throughput.
compute: The measured driver took 26.70 seconds; worker lifetime was 36.23 seconds. Across 133 GPU samples, median utilization was 98.0% and mean 84.41%; peak sampled memory was 37,669 MiB. Allocation, Drive authorization and installation are additional. Worker exit 0 and zero active Colab sessions were verified.
next: Proceed to model-size replication; do not increase chunk budgets merely to fill GPU memory.
